# Technology Partners International (TPI Nigeria)

> Technology Partners International (TPI) is Nigeria's leading environmental consultancy and engineering company, established in 1992. ISO-certified provider of environmental impact assessment, laboratory testing, waste management, engineering, and training services across Nigeria and West Africa.

## About TPI

Technology Partners International Nigeria Limited (TPI) is a trusted provider of environmental, laboratory, waste management, engineering, and advanced asset integrity services. Since 1992, TPI has been delivering high-quality solutions to clients in Nigeria and across the world. TPI holds ISO 9001:2015, ISO 14001:2015, ISO 45001:2018, and ISO/IEC 17025:2017 certifications.

- **Founded**: 1992
- **Headquarters**: 52/54 Oluwaleyimu Street, Off Toyin Street, Ikeja, Lagos State, Nigeria
- **Employees**: 200+
- **Offices**: Lagos, Port Harcourt, Warri, Conakry (Guinea)
- **Website**: https://www.tpigrp.com
- **Email**: info@tpigrp.com
- **Phone**: +234 8033030049

## Services

### Environmental Consultancy
- [Environmental Planning & Management](https://www.tpigrp.com/what-we-do/environment/environmental-planning-management): EIA, ESHIA, Environmental Management Plans, Regulatory Permitting
- [Environmental Compliance Monitoring](https://www.tpigrp.com/what-we-do/environment/environmental-compliance-monitoring): Air, water, soil quality monitoring
- [Environmental Site Assessment](https://www.tpigrp.com/what-we-do/environment/environmental-site-assessment): Phase I & II ESA, ESG risk identification
- [Climate Change & Sustainability](https://www.tpigrp.com/what-we-do/environment/climate-change-sustainability): GHG reporting, ESG advisory
- [Health, Social Engagement & Resettlement](https://www.tpigrp.com/what-we-do/environment/health-social-engagement): SIA, RAP, ESMF
- [Air Quality & Acoustics](https://www.tpigrp.com/what-we-do/environment/air-quality-acoustics): Ambient and indoor monitoring
- [Clean-Up & Remediation](https://www.tpigrp.com/what-we-do/environment/cleanup-remediation): Oil spill remediation
- [Hydrological Services](https://www.tpigrp.com/what-we-do/environment/hydrological-services): Water resource optimization
- [Geophysical Services](https://www.tpigrp.com/what-we-do/environment/geophysical-services): Subsurface investigations
- [GIS Services](https://www.tpigrp.com/what-we-do/environment/gis-services): Spatial data analysis, remote sensing

### Laboratory Services
- [General Laboratory Services](https://www.tpigrp.com/what-we-do/laboratory/general-laboratory-services): ISO 17025 accredited testing
- [Remote & Mobile Laboratory](https://www.tpigrp.com/what-we-do/laboratory/remote-mobile-laboratory): On-site analytical support
- [Eco-Toxicity Testing](https://www.tpigrp.com/what-we-do/laboratory/eco-toxicity): Biodegradability and bioaccumulation
- [Production Chemistry](https://www.tpigrp.com/what-we-do/laboratory/production-chemistry): Petroleum product testing
- [Geochemical Fingerprinting](https://www.tpigrp.com/what-we-do/laboratory/geochemical-fingerprinting): Crude oil analysis

### Waste Management
- [Integrated Solid Waste Management](https://www.tpigrp.com/what-we-do/waste-management/integrated-solid-waste)
- [Incineration Systems](https://www.tpigrp.com/what-we-do/waste-management/incinerator)
- [Thermal Desorption](https://www.tpigrp.com/what-we-do/waste-management/thermal-desorption)
- [Policy Formulation & Compliance](https://www.tpigrp.com/what-we-do/waste-management/waste-policy-formulation)

### Engineering & EPC
- [Engineering Design](https://www.tpigrp.com/what-we-do/engineering/engineering-design): Conceptual & FEED engineering
- [Asset Integrity Management](https://www.tpigrp.com/what-we-do/engineering/asset-integrity-management): RBI, NDT, corrosion monitoring

### Digital Solutions
- [Security & Software Solutions](https://www.tpigrp.com/what-we-do/digital-solutions/security-software-solutions)
- [Data Management & Reporting](https://www.tpigrp.com/what-we-do/digital-solutions/data-management-reporting)

### Training
- [ESG Training](https://www.tpigrp.com/what-we-do/training/esg-training)
